extruderArchitectures.name: Industrial Twin-Screw Co-Rotating Cooking Extruder (1,200 kg/h, 32:1 L/D, 8 Temperature Zones)
extruderArchitectures.classification: Commercial High-Shear Snack & Textured Protein Extruder (ASME BPVC Sec VIII & OSHA 1910.212)
extruderArchitectures.description: High-capacity twin-screw co-rotating modular food extruder for direct expanded snacks, breakfast cereals, and TVP. Features 8 independent induction-heated and water-cooled barrel zones, modular kneading blocks, high viscous shear dissipation, and dual rupture disc safety ports.

extruderArchitectures.name: Single-Screw High-Compression Pet Food & Starch Extruder (850 kg/h, 24:1 L/D, Grooved Feed Barrel)
extruderArchitectures.classification: Commercial Pet Food Kibble & Pregelatinized Starch Processing (FDA 21 CFR 110 & OSHA 1910.212)
extruderArchitectures.description: Heavy-duty single-screw cooking extruder equipped with spiral grooved feed throat, interrupted flight mixing pins, steam injection ports, and high compression ratio (3.5:1). Designed for continuous gelatinization of corn, wheat, and meat-and-bone meal formulations.

extruderArchitectures.name: High-Moisture Meat Analog (HMMA) Extruder with Long Cooling Die (450 kg/h, 40:1 L/D)
extruderArchitectures.classification: Advanced Plant-Based Protein Structuring & Viscous Rheology (EHEDG Doc 8 & ASME BPVC)
extruderArchitectures.description: Specialized twin-screw platform for plant-based meat fibers (soy, pea, gluten). Operates with high moisture feeds (55-65%) and high backpressures through a 3-meter refrigerated laminar cooling die, requiring precise viscous dissipation balance to prevent melt vaporization inside the barrel.

extruderArchitectures.name: Aging Legacy Single-Screw Extruder (Eroded Flight Clearance, Choked Die, Liner Scored)
extruderArchitectures.classification: High-Risk Degraded Extrusion Unit (Severe Back-Leakage, Surge Pressure & Motor Overload Risk)
extruderArchitectures.description: Worn production extruder with excessive screw-to-barrel flight clearance (1.85mm vs 0.3mm nominal), severe abrasive wear from silica in raw grains, and calcified water-cooling jackets. High leakage flow causes unstable pressure surges, melt scorching, and frequent motor thermal trips.

foodFormulationProfiles.name: Degermed Yellow Corn Meal (Expanded Snack Puffs / Curls, 14-16% Moisture)
foodFormulationProfiles.baseMaterial: Zea mays Endosperm (72% Starch, 8% Protein, 1% Lipid)
foodFormulationProfiles.description: High-expansion direct extruded snack formulation. Requires high shear rate and viscous dissipation to achieve rapid complete starch gelatinization and superheated water flashing at the die exit for low-density airy puff texture.

foodFormulationProfiles.name: Defatted Soy Flour TVP (Textured Vegetable Protein, 22-26% Moisture)
foodFormulationProfiles.baseMaterial: Glycine max Protein (53% Protein, 32% Carbs, <1% Fat)
foodFormulationProfiles.description: Textured soy protein requiring thermal-mechanical protein unfolding, intermolecular disulfide cross-linking, and laminar alignment in the high-shear metering zone. Sensitive to over-shearing which shreds fibrous protein strands.

foodFormulationProfiles.name: Premium Canine Kibble (Poultry Meal, Rice & Wheat, 20-22% Moisture)
foodFormulationProfiles.baseMaterial: Animal Protein & Cereal Grain Blend (28% Protein, 14% Fat, 40% Starch)
foodFormulationProfiles.description: Balanced pet food kibble requiring starch gelatinization for digestibility and structural cohesion without nutrient degradation (lysine loss, vitamin oxidation). High bone mineral fractions induce abrasive barrel wear.

foodFormulationProfiles.name: High-Moisture Pea & Wheat Gluten Blend (Plant-Based Chicken Strip, 58% Moisture)
foodFormulationProfiles.baseMaterial: Pea Protein Isolate & Vital Wheat Gluten (65% Moisture Slurry)
foodFormulationProfiles.description: High-moisture meat analog dough. Relies on anisotropic cooling die shear to form long, striated muscle-like fibrous textures. High pressure in the die prevents steam flash and voids in the fibrous matrix.

screwBarrelMetallurgies.name: Bimetallic Barrel Liner (Centrifugally Cast Tungsten Carbide Matrix, 62-65 HRC)
screwBarrelMetallurgies.wearResistanceRating: Exceptional (Resistant to abrasive mineral fillers and high-shear adhesive galling)

screwBarrelMetallurgies.name: Gas Nitrided Alloy Tool Steel (SACM645 / DIN 1.8550, 0.6mm Case, 58-62 HRC)
screwBarrelMetallurgies.wearResistanceRating: Good (Standard food contact wear resistance, vulnerable to acidic fruit/sauce pitting)

screwBarrelMetallurgies.name: Worn Uncoated 4140 Chrome-Moly Steel (Deeply Grooved & Eroded, 32-36 HRC)
screwBarrelMetallurgies.wearResistanceRating: Poor (Severe adhesive smearing, rapid flight gap expansion, metal particulate contamination)
